project.name: NamastePOS
project.idea: Mobile-first, offline-ready restaurant POS & billing SaaS for India: billing, KOT/KDS, table & captain modes, QR self-ordering, GST-compliant invoicing, loyalty/wallet, live reports from any Android phone — keeps working when the internet drops.

sprints.goal: Unblock listings + billing (founder actions) and ship social/brand assets
Non-AI high value: dynamic UPI QR, update prompt + min-version gate, e-invoice/WhatsApp readiness, reseller kit + referral button, GST toggle (platform + restaurant)
AI features 1–7 (Claude API): menu import, Hinglish WhatsApp digest, ask-your-data, wastage alerts, voice POS, review replies, support bot

requirements.text: Nightly DB backup to Cloudflare R2 (namastepos-backups) — founder must create bucket + token + GitHub secrets, then run 'DB backup' workflow
www.namastepos.in → namastepos.in 301 redirect rule in Cloudflare
Restaurant GST toggle (on/off, 5%/18%, unregistered scheme) in web dashboard and app
Platform subscription invoices must not show GST while platform is unregistered

adrs.title: Supabase (free) over Neon for production Postgres
adrs.decision: Neon metered hours-awake and paused; Supabase Free pauses only after 7 idle days with no compute-hour cap. Keep-alive pings /v1/health every 5 min so DB is queried continuously. Watch 500 MB storage (≈45 MB used) and 5 GB egress.

adrs.title: Render Free for the API with 5-min keep-alive + UptimeRobot
adrs.decision: Spins down after 15 min idle; ping keeps it warm. 750 instance-hours/month = exactly one 24/7 service — never add a second free service. No SLA, no provider backups → nightly R2 backup is mandatory.

adrs.title: CI deploy-api is gated on backend tests; scheduled CI runs only marketing-claims-live
adrs.decision: On push, deploy-api skips whenever backend fails (safety gate). Scheduled runs only check landing claims vs plan feed; other jobs skipped by design.
